name: La Masó (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross patty throughout, charged at the upper hoist with a black house (domus).
history: The flag of La Masó is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with a red full cross patty with arms of thickness 1/6 of the height at the centre and 3/10 at the ends, and the black domus of the arms at the upper hoist; the Templar cross refers to the old lords of La Masó, and the domus is a canting sign. Published in the DOGC on 26 April 2000.

features.role: cross patty throughout with flared ends
